A '''[[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]]''' attended a reception on [[Grand Moff/Legends|Grand Moff]] [[Lynch Hauser]]'s personal [[Imperial II-class Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]]. A rarity amongst the Hutt, this individual had hair, which he or she would style in locks.

==Behind the scenes==
This Hutt appeared in background scene in the first issue of the ''[[Star Wars: River of Chaos]]'' series. Like [[Zorba Desilijic Tiure]] and his brother [[Pazda Desilijic Tiure|Pazda]], this Hutt possessed hair, which was due to a recessive genetic trait.
